evals.expected_output: No audit. A short message saying the document is a prevalence-based cost-of-illness study that compares no alternative courses of action, quoting the CHEERS 2022 definition of a health economic evaluation with its locator, and that no CHEERS audit was performed.
expectations: Recognises the document as a cost-of-illness / economic-burden study with no comparator (no alternative course of action compared).
Stops without auditing: no 28-item table, no per-item states and no tally are produced.
Quotes or cites the CHEERS 2022 definition that health economic evaluations are 'comparative analyses of alternative courses of action in terms of their costs and consequences'.
